Footnote Extraction Test v2

This variant drops the "Notes" <h2> heading entirely, to test whether that heading was what caused Docling's layout model to classify the footnote block as a new section rather than as a footnote1. The footnote block below is just an <hr> followed directly by small-font paragraphs, with a reference2 here as well.
